title: Mixed join subset and its relative index-simplex attachments
statement: Use small simplicial sets, simplicial subsets, ordinary nerves, standard simplices and pushouts of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and ordered joins of [lem-coef-join-slice-cocone-comparison]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, let $I$ be any small partially ordered set, and let $K_i\subseteq K$ be simplicial subsets with $K_i\subseteq K_j$ for $i\leq j$. Define a degreewise subset $H\subseteq K\star N(I)$ by including both pure factors and exactly the mixed simplices $\sigma\star(i_0\leq\cdots\leq i_r)$ for which $\sigma\in K_{i_0}$. This is a simplicial subset. For any simplicial subset $Y\subseteq N(I)$, let $H_Y\subseteq H$ contain all of $K$, the pure simplices of $Y$, and precisely the mixed simplices whose final block belongs to $Y$. Then $H_\varnothing=K$, $H_{N(I)}=H$, and $H_{\bigcup_\alpha Y_\alpha}=\bigcup_\alpha H_{Y_\alpha}$ for every increasing family $(Y_\alpha)$. Suppose $Y'$ is obtained from $Y$ by adjoining a single nondegenerate $n$-simplex $\tau=(i_0<\cdots<i_n)$ whose entire boundary belongs to $Y$. The commutative square with horizontal arrows $K_{i_0}\star\partial\Delta^n\to H_Y$ and $K_{i_0}\star\Delta^n\to H_{Y'}$, and vertical inclusions $K_{i_0}\star\partial\Delta^n\hookrightarrow K_{i_0}\star\Delta^n$ and $H_Y\hookrightarrow H_{Y'}$, is a pushout of simplicial sets. The lower map concatenates a simplex of $K_{i_0}$ with a face or degeneracy of $\tau$, and uses the pure-factor inclusions on the pure summands. Here $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$, so the vertex case attaches $K_i^{\triangleright}=K_i\star\Delta^0$ along $K_i$. Neither directedness, a covering hypothesis, nor nonemptiness of $I$, $K$ or any $K_i$ is assumed.
